title: Pinecone
description: Fully managed cloud vector database with serverless indexes, integrated metadata filters, and built-in hybrid search combining dense and sparse vectors.

title: Qdrant
description: Rust-based vector search engine with named dense and sparse vectors, native Reciprocal Rank Fusion in the Universal Query API, and payload-based filtering.
pricing: free and open-source; self-hosted or cloud

title: Chroma
description: Simple embeddable vector store with collection-level metadata filtering and optional embedding functions. Runs on Docker for local development.

title: Weaviate
description: Vector database with built-in modules for vectorization, hybrid search using BM25 and dense vectors, and GraphQL-style querying.
